You appear in Northshire Valley, in front of the abbey. Deputy Willem (48.2, 43.0) stands a few steps north of you with your first orders. Take every quest a person offers before you head out.

A new human also holds a Northshire Gift Voucher. If yours is still in your bags, hand it to Merissa Stilwell in the abbey - characters who arrive from elsewhere (Skyborne coming off the Zephras route) will not have one, so the line is optional.

Two sets of abbey quests are not in this guide's tracker list: your class letter from Marshal McBride, and Brother Paxton's book quests (Book Inventory, Rascally Rodents and their follow-ups). Do them anyway - they run in the same fields as everything below.
